fact: Telecom Egypt and Orange Egypt signed agreements worth about EGP 15bn that extend transmission services to 2032, with Telecom Egypt providing the other operator's capacity.
Telecom Egypt says it extended its transmission services to Orange Egypt until 2032 and signed a three-year fibre-to-the-site contract, in a package of about EGP 15 billion.
Telecom Egypt says it provides infrastructure, connectivity and wholesale services to all other operators and extended its transmission services agreement with Vodafone Egypt to 2031.
